entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to return my VeloBand Pulse. It's not working right.
I'm certainly sorry to hear you're having trouble with your VeloBand. To make sure I understand correctly, is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's a technical fault. The heart rate is all over the place. Honestly, this thing is a piece of garbage.

I understand your frustration, and that definitely shouldn't be happening. I've pulled up your account and see you received the band 16 days ago. The first step for a technical issue like this is to connect you with our tech support team. They have a few quick diagnostic steps that usually resolve sensor inaccuracies.
Ugh, I really don't have time for all that. I've been a loyal customer for a long time, and I expected better. I just want my money back. Can we please just process the refund?

I can appreciate you wanting a quick resolution. For the VeloBand Pulse specifically, we have a 10-day window for returns. After that point, for a defect claim, our policy requires that we verify the fault with our technical team before we can authorize a return.
But it's broken. Why do I have to jump through hoops? I really needed this money for some bills, and now I'm stuck with this. It feels so unfair.

I do understand your position, and I wish there was more I could do directly. The policy is in place because once the device is activated, it's linked to an account, and for hygiene reasons after 10 days, we can't accept it back without a verified manufacturer's defect. Without letting our team confirm the issue, I'm unable to override that system block.
So you're just not going to help me? I'm telling you it's defective, and you're telling me it's my problem. I just want a refund, that's all.

I want to help you get a working product. But without verification, I'm unable to process a return as it falls outside the 10-day policy. My options are to either transfer you to technical support for troubleshooting or, if you'd prefer, I can explain how to list it on the VeloFit Resale Marketplace.
I can't believe this. I've spent so much money with VeloFit over the years. I guess that doesn't matter. Fine. I'll just... figure it out. Thanks for nothing.
I am truly sorry this isn't the outcome you were hoping for. The offer to connect you with tech support still stands if you change your mind. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
